profile_intent: Conservative rule gates for REAPER automation, fullmix rescue, stem work, Suno DeAI cleanup, and master-bus processing.

forbidden_language.true rebeat: Requires REAPER timeline evidence for reconstructed drums, bass, and music elements.
forbidden_language.beat fully re-created: Requires auditable MIDI/audio reconstruction and separate drum/bass/music render evidence.
forbidden_language.vocal fully tuned: Requires pitch contour detection, edit evidence, and before/after validation.
forbidden_language.stem mix: Requires active imported stems in the project and stem render/audit evidence.
forbidden_language.lossless restoration: Forbidden for MP3 or other lossy sources.
forbidden_language.noise completely removed: Artifact reduction can be measured; complete removal must not be claimed.
forbidden_language.professional final master: Requires passing QC plus human listening approval.
forbidden_language.reference matched perfectly: Reference matching is advisory and cannot be perfect.

rules.MS-001: M/S EQ is allowed only for a named side wash, stereo harshness, mono low-end, center protection, side cleanup, or width stabilization reason.
rules.MS-002: Control risky low-end side energy gently; do not remove intentional safe stereo bass.
rules.MS-003: Protect Mid 1-4 kHz unless vocal harshness is proven.
rules.MS-004: Treat excessive 5-16 kHz side harshness with side-aware dynamic reduction before broad stereo dulling.
rules.MS-005: Warn if side/mid ratio changes beyond threshold; fail collapsed-width candidates.
rules.MS-006: Report every M/S band, target, static/dynamic type, reduction, reason, risk, and side/mid before/after.
rules.RES-001: Detect likely resonance before broad EQ.
rules.RES-002: Use high-Q or dynamic notch for narrow ringing and report frequency/Q.
rules.RES-003: Use limited dynamic EQ for unstable AI harsh bands; do not flatten the top end.
rules.RES-004: Use dynamic low-mid control when buildup is intermittent; preserve body.
rules.RES-005: Guard resonance moves against vocal presence, brightness, transient, hollowness, and reference overfit loss.
rules.RES-006: Warn or reject if resonance control worsens punch, vocal clarity, or tonal balance.
rules.DEESS-001: Use de-essing only when sibilance proxy or listening notes justify it.
rules.DEESS-002: If isolated vocal exists, de-ess vocal before fullmix.
rules.DEESS-003: If only fullmix exists, use conservative de-essing and report risk.
rules.DEESS-004: Use vocal and artifact-aware sibilance bands, not broad treble cuts.
rules.DEESS-005: Reject de-essing that lisps vocals, removes cymbals, dulls air, drops presence, muffles the track, or reduces transients.
rules.DEESS-006: Report target, band, max reduction, expected improvement, brightness guard, and candidate pass/fail.
rules.COMP-001: Compression must solve a defined problem.
rules.COMP-002: Attack time must match the source and punch goal.
rules.COMP-003: Release time must avoid distortion, pumping, and groove flattening.
rules.COMP-004: DnB and bass-heavy material must protect transient and punch proxies.
rules.COMP-005: Vocal compression must not raise noise or sibilance without targeted control.
rules.COMP-006: Master bus compression must be conservative, especially on mastered MP3 sources.
rules.COMP-007: Reject compression if transient proxy, punch, harshness, or pumping guards fail.
rules.DYNEQ-001: Master dynamic EQ is subtle control, not a mix rewrite.
rules.DYNEQ-002: Use dynamic EQ for intermittent spikes, buildup, side fizz, resonance, and limiter-triggering sub.
rules.DYNEQ-003: Do not chase a perfect graph.
rules.DYNEQ-004: Report frequency range, Q/bandwidth, threshold concept, max reduction, attack/release, reason, and risk.
rules.DYNEQ-005: Reject master dynamic EQ that pushes vocal back, dulls cymbals, weakens punch, shrinks the mix, works the limiter harder, or collapses sides.
rules.SUNO-001: Suno/AI cleanup is multi-objective: reduce artifacts while preserving punch, vocal clarity, brightness, width, and transients.
rules.SUNO-002: Use mild/medium intensity by default; strong/extreme require extra evidence and are not default finals.
rules.SUNO-003: Increasing DeAI intensity requires brightness, transient, side/mid, vocal presence, and punch checks.
rules.SUNO-004: Reject DeAI that dulls highs, weakens emotion, collapses stereo, smears transients, weakens punch, or loses musical detail.
rules.SUNO-005: MP3 sources require codec limitation reporting and no lossless restoration claim.
rules.SUNO-006: Custom Suno DeAI plugins require existence, JSFX smoke check where possible, FXChain name verification, render evidence, and report filename/version.
rules.REF-002: Compare reference by bands, loudness, transient profile, and side/mid.
rules.REF-003: Do not match a reference when arrangement, genre, density, dynamics, or safety disagree.
rules.REF-004: Report reference file, confidence, tonal deltas, accepted changes, rejected changes, and reason.
rules.REF-005: If no valid reference exists, use genre profile and do not invent a reference.
